chars.HUSBAND: HUSBAND: a Moroccan man aged 38, short black hair, trimmed beard, wearing a mustard-yellow knit sweater over a white collar shirt, dark blue jeans
chars.WIFE: WIFE: a heavily pregnant Moroccan woman aged 33, wearing a lilac headscarf and a long teal kaftan-style house dress with white embroidery

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan apartment living room with zellige details, HUSBAND smiling a slightly too-perfect smile carries a tray with mint tea and a glass of juice to WIFE who rests on a sofa holding her big belly, she smiles back gratefully; warm daylight

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: HUSBAND alone in a small Moroccan bathroom looking at himself in the mirror, half-smile, one eyebrow raised, calculating cold eyes, reflection clearly visible; soft evening light

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small car on a Moroccan city street in daytime, HUSBAND driving calmly with both hands on the wheel while WIFE in the passenger seat grimaces in labor pain clutching her belly; seen from the windshield

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan hospital delivery room, WIFE lying on the hospital bed in a light blue hospital gown with her lilac headscarf, sweating and in pain, HUSBAND sitting beside the bed holding her hand tenderly, reassuring her

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan hospital room, HUSBAND leans close to WIFE's ear as if telling a secret with a calm sly look, holding his phone in his other hand, WIFE on the hospital bed in a light blue gown and lilac headscarf looks up at him puzzled

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan hospital room, WIFE in a light blue hospital gown and lilac headscarf sits up suddenly on the bed, eyes wide in panic, hand raised toward HUSBAND as if asking why, HUSBAND stands at the bedside calm

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: Moroccan hospital room, HUSBAND stands at the foot of the bed with arms crossed and an icy calm stare, WIFE on the bed in a light blue gown and lilac headscarf looks at him frozen, speechless

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: Close view of WIFE on the hospital bed in a light blue gown and lilac headscarf, her face turning pale with terror, mouth open, staring at the door; HUSBAND blurred in the background by the window
